correctness.rationale: The source reconstructs GP(12,5) as the 24-permutation star-transposition graph; the 144 distinct S4 x S3 maps saturate the automorphism bound. Its radius-three Rips complex is the simplicial join of two 12-vertex orientable tori (each f=(12,36,24), all vertex links six-cycles and oriented triangle propagation). The integral join formula yields only H3,H4,H5 of ranks 4,4,1. Graded swap signs distinguish side-preserving and side-exchanging elements. Torus signed Lefschetz counts and exact S4/S3 character inner products produce the stated three module decompositions. Independently regenerated all 5328 joined nonempty simplices, 144 maps and signed full-complex Lefschetz identities from the package-defined graph; all 15 class triples agree with character_table.json. The finite enumeration proves this exact finite object, not other graphs/scales.
